scientific_integrity: Primary published structure and rank decompositions are credited; only joint-rank commuting enumeration and resulting exact exponential series are assessed as the new result. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only nonautomorphism semigroup endomorphisms for n>=5; excludes group of units and degree-four exceptional rank-seven endomorphisms. Relies on published structural normal form. Finite checks are not infinite proofs; historical priority beyond inspected sources is unverified.
title: A joint-rank census of commuting singular endomorphisms of full transformation semigroups
